name: Master Your Career Path
source: Read from the live site's home page styles (index.html)

colours.name: Navy
colours.role: Main brand colour: backgrounds, headings on light

voice: Encouraging, practical and aspirational without motivational fluff; straight-talking and peer-to-peer, never preachy.
imagery: Real-looking professionals at work, not staged stock smiles.
When people appear, show a mix of nationalities and ethnicities; never one default face.
Simple diagrams of the PRIME and OPERATE steps work well as infographics.
logo: Logo files exist only on Didi's computer (from the PRIME review). Add them to Drive under 99 Brand Assets.
doNot: No motivational cliches or hustle language.
Do not put white text on gold: it is too faint to read.
toConfirm: Prices in pounds or dollars on cards?
Confirm the logo version to use on social cards.
